🤝 We're Hiring: Business Development Contractor
💵 Pay: $35–$50 per hour
🇺🇸 Location: United States Remote
🕒 Type: Hourly Contract Up to 40 Hours/Week
🏢 Company: Mercor

📩 Apply today: https://t.mercor.com/OlcLU

🚀 Role Overview
Mercor is hiring experienced Business Development Contractors to identify companies with valuable operational data and develop potential data-licensing partnerships.
This is an external-facing role focused on outreach, relationship building, discovery calls, and managing partnership opportunities from initial contact through signed agreements.
📋 Key Responsibilities
✅ Identify and contact prospective data partners
✅ Conduct outbound outreach to founders and business owners
✅ Lead discovery calls and explain partnership opportunities
✅ Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders
✅ Address questions related to:
• Data Use
• Privacy
• Security
• Anonymization
✅ Manage opportunities from initial outreach through closing
✅ Coordinate partner onboarding with internal teams
🎯 Ideal Candidate Profile
✔️ Strong communication and relationship-building skills
✔️ Experience in:
• Business Development
• Partnerships
• B2B Sales
• Client Acquisition
✔️ Comfortable with outbound sales and outreach
✔️ Confident speaking with:
• Founders
• Executives
• Business Owners
• Senior Stakeholders
✔️ Experience managing fast-moving sales cycles
✔️ Able to work independently and manage leads effectively
✔️ Available to contribute up to 40 hours/week
🌟 Why Join?
✅ $35–$50/hour competitive compensation
✅ Fully remote within the United States
✅ Flexible independent contractor engagement
✅ Weekly payments via Stripe or Wise
✅ Work on high-impact data partnership opportunities
✅ Collaborate with fast-moving teams and business leaders
📝 Application
• Submit your resume
• Complete the required application process
• Selected candidates receive next steps and onboarding details
